D.t: Debbie Wasserman Schultz leads by 55.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 151,014 votes; a one point swing is about 1,372 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +48.1 and D +61.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
